title: ExyliaMedia
description: Have your content creators advertise their live streams or videos.
body:
# Exylia Media
### Let Your Players Share Their Content in Style

### Why Choose Exylia Media?
Want to build a creator-friendly community? **Exylia Media** transforms your Velocity network into a content-sharing hub where players can promote their videos and livestreams with beautiful, spam-free broadcasts.

---

## ✨ Key Features

### Smart Media Sharing
- Dedicated commands for videos and livestreams  
- Beautiful centered broadcast messages across the network  
- Fully customizable message formats with MiniMessage support  

### Platform Validation
- Built-in support for YouTube, Twitch, and Kick  
- Extensible platform system — add custom platforms easily  
- URL validation to prevent spam and invalid links  

### ⏱️ Anti-Spam Protection
- Per-player, per-media-type cooldowns  
- Configurable cooldown durations  

---

## Commands
```text
/video <url>            - Share your latest video with the network
/stream <url>           - Announce your livestream to everyone
/exyliamediadmin reload - Reload plugin configuration
````

## Permissions

```text
exyliamediadmin.bypass  - Bypass cooldowns
exyliamediadmin.reload  - Reload command
```

## Requirements

* **Platform:** Velocity Proxy
* **Java Version:** 17+
* **Dependencies:** None
